DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた傘のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the umbrella you lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紺色の長い傘です。入口で同じ色の傘を見たので、私の物かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失した傘の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is a long navy blue umbrella. I saw one the same color at the entrance and thought it might be mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the features of the umbrella you lost. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色だけでは分かりませんので、他の特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot tell from the color alone, so let me ask about other features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手に白いひもを付けています。それから、一本だけ骨の先に小さな傷があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手の白いひもと、一本の骨の先にある小さな傷を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have attached a white cord to the handle. Also, there is a small scratch at the tip of just one rib.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the white cord on the handle and the small scratch at the tip of one rib. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所と、なくしたと気付いた時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know where you last used it and what time you noticed it was missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、駅前の店で使いました。帰宅して傘がないと気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日駅前の店で使い、帰宅後に傘がないと気付いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it yesterday at a shop in front of the station. When I got home, I noticed I did not have my umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you used the umbrella at a shop near the station yesterday and noticed it was missing after returning home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いている物と照合する手続きを行います。入口の傘には触れずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will carry out the procedure to compare it with the items handed in. Please wait without touching the umbrella at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。似ているだけで自分の物と決めず、ひもと傷を係の方に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認の手続きを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I will not assume it is mine just because it looks similar; I will have a staff member check the cord and scratch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the verification procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の結果が出るまでは、こちらの紛失届に必要な情報をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until the check is complete, please fill in the required information on this lost-property report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入します。入口の傘を先に持って帰らず、届けと照合の結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認の傘を持ち帰らず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill it in. I will not take the umbrella at the entrance home first; I will wait for the report and comparison results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without taking the unverified umbrella home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。特徴と経過を受け付け、届出の情報と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will record its features and what happened, and compare them with the information in the reports.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の荷物を受け取りに来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to collect the parcel on your missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この店で頼んだ靴を受け取りたいです。注文画面と不在票を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文した靴の受取を希望し注文画面と不在票を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to collect the shoes I ordered from this shop. I brought the order screen and the missed-delivery notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wish to collect the shoes you ordered and show the order screen and missed-delivery notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文画面には発送準備中とあります。不在票の番号と同じ荷物か、確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The order screen says it is being prepared for dispatch. Have you confirmed that it is the same parcel as the number on the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確認していません。どちらも自分宛てなので、靴の不在票だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ宛名だから同一荷物と思ったが番号は未照合だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not checked. They are both addressed to me, so I assumed the notice was for the shoes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that you thought it was the same parcel because the addressee was the same, but have not compared the numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名が同じだけでは、同じ荷物とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same addressee alone does not mean they are the same parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 注文番号を追跡番号の欄へ入れてしまいました。種類が違うので、同じ番号として扱うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文番号と追跡番号を混同した入力を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I entered the order number in the tracking-number field. They are different types of numbers, so I will stop treating them as the same number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the entry where you confused the order number with the tracking number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在票の情報はこちらで確認し、注文の発送状況は販売店へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the information on the missed-delivery notice here. Please ask the seller about the dispatch status of your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。不在票の差出人を見て、この荷物についての受取を相談します。靴は店へ発送状況を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在票の荷物と店の未発送注文を分けて各担当へ確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will look at the sender on the notice and ask about collecting that parcel. I will ask the shop about the shoes' dispatch status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the parcel on the notice from the shop's unshipped order and check with the respective staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つを分けて伺います。今この窓口にあるかも担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will handle those as two separate matters. The person responsible will also check whether the parcel is currently at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴がここへ届いたとは言いません。不在票の番号で確認を待ち、注文画面は別にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴の到着を断言せず不在票番号で確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not say the shoes have arrived here. I will wait for the check using the notice number and put the order screen away separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assert that the shoes have arrived and will wait for verification using the notice number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不在票の番号で保管状況を確認し、この荷物の受取方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the storage status using the notice number and explain how to collect this parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見つかったカードについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a card you found, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日私のカードを止めましたが、家の引き出しに同じ銀行のカードがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止後に同銀行のカードを発見したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I had my card blocked yesterday, but there was a card from the same bank in a drawer at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found a card from the same bank after blocking your card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券面のお名前をご確認ください。ご自身のカードでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the name printed on the card. Is it your own card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の名前でした。銀行と色が同じなので、自分の物が見つかったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券面名義が父で自分の物ではないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was my father's name. The bank and color were the same, so I thought I had found my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself, saying the card bears your father's name and is not yours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お父様のカードがあることと、お客様のカードの所在は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Having your father's card and knowing where your own card is are separate matters, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私のカードはまだありません。昨日の停止の受付控えを出すので、その状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分のカードは未発見だと伝え停止受付控えで状態確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My card is still missing. I will show you the receipt for yesterday's blocking request, so please check its status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your own card has not been found and ask for a status check using the blocking-request receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の確認をして、担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will verify your identity and connect you with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父のカードを私の口座の確認に使うのはやめます。父にも、ここへ持ってきたことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父のカードを自分の確認に使わず持参したことを父へ伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not use my father's card to check my own account. I will also tell my father I brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not use your father's card for your own verification and will tell him you brought it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お父様のカードを使って、お客様の口座を確認することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We cannot use your father's card to check your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 父のカードは別にしまいます。私の控えと本人確認の資料で、まだ紛失中のカードについて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別人のカードと分け自分の資料で紛失中として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my father's card away separately. I will use my own receipt and identification documents to ask about my card, which is still missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the other person's card separate and consult about your missing card using your own documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様のカードは未発見として、昨日の受付状況を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person responsible will check yesterday's request, treating your card as still not found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入商品の内容についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the contents of a product you bought, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。このセットを開けましたが、写真の小皿が入っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入っていない物を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I opened this set, but the small plate in the photo was not included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain what was not included. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の内容表示を一緒に確認しましょう。どこを見て小皿も入ると思われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the contents listed on the box together. What made you think the small plate was included too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表の写真です。料理の横に小皿があるので、それもセットの一部だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で付属品だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The photo on the front. There is a small plate next to the food, so I thought it was part of the set too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you thought the item in the photo was an accessory included with the set. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容の欄には二点とあり、写真の小皿には「使用例、付属しません」と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The contents section lists two items, and the small plate in the photo has a note saying, “Example of use; not included.”

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい文字を見落としていました。箱にある二点はそろっているので、欠品ではなかったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: セット内容の表示を一緒に読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I missed the small print. Both items listed on the box are present, so there was no missing item after all.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the list of set contents together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示上の二点は、こちらの品物ですね。小皿は別の商品になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: These are the two items listed. The small plate is a separate product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。中身の不足として交換を頼むのではなく、小皿を別に探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と記載の違いを理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. Instead of requesting an exchange for missing contents, I would like to look for a small plate separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the difference between the photo and the written description. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食器の売り場をご案内できます。商品の大きさに合うかをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can direct you to the tableware section. Please check whether the size suits the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。買った二点はこのまま使い、必要な小皿だけ売り場で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な物を別に探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will use the two items I bought as they are and choose just the small plate I need in that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to look separately for what you need. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。内容を確認できましたので、食器売り場の位置をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Now that we have checked the contents, I will show you where the tableware section is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩場所をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to take a rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。このベンチが雨でぬれていて、座ると服までぬれそうです。別に休める所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ぬれたベンチで困っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This bench is wet from the rain, and my clothes might get wet if I sit down. Is there somewhere else I can rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are having trouble because the bench is wet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 園内の休憩小屋に、屋根の下のベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are benches under the roof in the park's rest shelter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 屋根があっても、横から雨が入ったかもしれませんね。座面は今、乾いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座れる休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even with a roof, rain may have blown in from the side. Are the seats dry at the moment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a place where you can sit and rest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先ほど見た時は奥の席が乾いていました。到着した時にもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The seats at the back were dry when I looked a little while ago. Please check again when you get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。小屋へは、この芝生を横切れば近いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小屋へ行くには芝生を横切ると近いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: All right. Is it shorter to cross this lawn to get to the shelter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether crossing the lawn is a shorter way to the hut. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 芝生もぬれていますので、舗装された道で池の手前を回ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The lawn is wet too, so please take the paved path around the near side of the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 靴をぬらさないように、舗装路を使います。池まで行く前に小屋が見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: そこまでの経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the paved path so my shoes do not get wet. Will I see the shelter before I reach the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to get there. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、角を曲がると左側に見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once you turn the corner, you will see it on your left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その道で行き、奥の座面を見てから座ります。こちらのぬれたベンチは使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乾いた席を見てから休むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go that way and check the seats at the back before sitting down. I will not use this wet bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check for a dry seat before resting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。池の手前で左をご覧になり、空いている乾いた席でお休みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Look to the left before the pond, and rest in an unoccupied dry seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符は何枚ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many tickets would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大人三人分です。この割引券を一枚持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人分の購入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: For three adults. I have one of these discount vouchers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to buy tickets for three people. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券面には、ご本人一人分のみ対象と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The voucher states that it applies only to the holder's own ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚で同行者も全員割引になるのではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 割引券の対象人数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So a single voucher does not give everyone accompanying me a discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how many people the discount voucher covers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。他のお二人は通常の券になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is correct. The other two people will need regular tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、私の一枚に割引券を使い、二人分は通常でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分だけの条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please use the voucher for my ticket and charge the regular price for the other two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the condition that it covers only one person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。割引の条件に合う利用日も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. I will also check that the date of use meets the discount conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 利用日は今日です。券に書かれた対象期間に入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用日は今日だと伝え、券の対象期間に入っているか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will use them today. That is within the eligible period printed on the voucher, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the ticket today and check that today falls within its eligible period. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。割引一枚と通常二枚で、金額はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Here is the total for one discounted ticket and two regular tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内訳を確認しました。三枚でこの金額ですね。まとめて払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内訳を確認して支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the breakdown. This is the total for three tickets, correct? I will pay for them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the breakdown and pay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。三枚の切符と、ご本人分に適用した内訳をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Here are your three tickets and the breakdown showing the discount applied to your own ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ家に似た通知が二通届きました。一枚は重複かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た通知が二通届いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two similar notices arrived at the same home. I thought one might be a duplicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you received two similar notices. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの宛名を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the addressee on each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚は私、もう一枚は妻です。世帯の住所は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is for me and the other is for my wife. Our household address is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the different addressees. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象期間も違うようですね。下の欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The periods they cover seem different too. Please look at the field below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の分は今月、妻の分は来月です。見た目だけでは重複と決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象期間を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mine is for this month, and my wife's is for next month. We cannot decide they are duplicates just from how they look.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the periods covered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容と必要な対応は担当課へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the contents and required actions with the department responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二通とも持って行きます。片方だけ出すと、妻の分の相談が抜けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方を担当に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take both notices. If I show only one, we would leave out the matter concerning my wife.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have the person responsible check both notices. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。宛名と期間を分けてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please discuss them separately by addressee and period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人それぞれの通知として確認します。どちらも捨てず、担当に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片方を捨てず持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check them as separate notices for each of us. I will not throw either away and will show both to the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring both without throwing one away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの担当窓口へ、二通をそろえてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring both notices together to this counter responsible for the matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。紹介状はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit, correct? Do you have a referral letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、封筒があります。受付の用紙に書くため、先に中を読む必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I have the envelope. Do I need to read its contents first to fill in the reception form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought a referral letter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりしますので、ご自身で開けずにお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take it here, so please hand it in without opening it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ開けていません。このまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紹介状はまだ開けておらず、そのまま渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened it yet. I will hand it over as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not opened the referral letter and will hand it over as it is. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご自身で記入するのは、こちらの問診票です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. This medical questionnaire is the form you should fill in yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紹介状の内容を写すのではなく、今の症状や分かる情報を書くんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紹介状を写すのではなく、今の症状や分かる情報を書くのだと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should write my current symptoms and information I know, rather than copy the referral letter's contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should write your current symptoms and information you know, rather than copy the referral letter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。不明な項目は、記入前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If there is any field you do not understand, please ask before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からない医療用語を推測せず、問診票だけ書きます。紹介状は別にお預けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別に記入する問診票を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will fill in only the questionnaire without guessing unfamiliar medical terms. I will leave the referral letter with you separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the separate questionnaire you need to fill in. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。問診票が書けたら、こちらへ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please return here when you have finished the questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。こちらが問診票で、未開封の紹介状は先ほどお渡しした封筒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紹介状と問診票を分けて提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished. This is the questionnaire, and the unopened referral letter is in the envelope I handed you earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the referral letter and questionnaire separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、両方を確認しました。担当へ渡し、お名前をお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we have checked both. We will pass them to the person responsible and call your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った財布をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought in a wallet you found, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。交差点の手前の歩道にありました。拾った時は口が開いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布の発見場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was on the pavement just before the intersection. It was open when I picked it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where you found the wallet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身を取り出したり、金額を数えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you take anything out or count the money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。紙幣が見えましたが、いくらかは数えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙幣は見えたが、金額は数えていないと明確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I could see banknotes, but I did not count how much there was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you saw banknotes but did not count the amount. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 運ぶ時に、財布の状態を変えたところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you change anything about the wallet's condition while bringing it here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中身が落ちないように口を閉じました。それ以外は触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身が落ちないよう財布の口を閉じ、それ以外は触っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I closed it so the contents would not fall out. I have not touched anything else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you closed the wallet to stop the contents falling out and did not touch anything else. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。発見時と、今の状態を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I see. We will record separately how it was when you found it and how it is now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 拾った時は開いていて、運ぶために閉じた、という経過ですね。中身はここで確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閉じて運んだ経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was open when I picked it up, and I closed it to carry it here. I would like you to check the contents here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you closed it to bring it here. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。拾った時刻もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please also tell me what time you picked it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。この閉じた状態の財布をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の状態で係員へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: About ten minutes ago. I will hand over the wallet in its current closed condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand it to the staff member in its current condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。発見場所、時刻、口を閉じた経過とあわせてお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will take it together with the details of where and when you found it and how you closed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外へ送るお荷物の中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what is inside the parcel you want to send overseas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 充電器二つです。家族へ送ります。ケーブルと、この携帯用の電源を入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の内容を充電器二つと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two chargers. I am sending them to my family. I put in a cable and this portable power supply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the box's contents as two chargers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つは同じ種類ではなさそうですね。電池がある物か、分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those two items do not look like the same type. Do you know whether either contains a battery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ケーブルにはありません。携帯用の電源は、コンセントにつながなくても電話を充電できます。中の電池の情報はまだ調べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケーブルと内蔵電池情報が不明な携帯電源を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The cable does not. The portable power supply can charge a phone without being plugged into a socket. I have not checked the information about its internal battery yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the cable from the portable power supply whose built-in battery information is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電源の表示や仕様を確認し、送れる条件を担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the labeling and specifications of the power supply and ask the person responsible about the conditions for sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まとめて充電器二つと書かず、ケーブル一本と携帯用の電源一台に分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容品の名称と数量を具体的に分けて申告すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of writing “two chargers” for both together, I will describe them separately as one cable and one portable power supply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will declare the names and quantities of the contents separately and specifically. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。仕様の分かる資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Do you have any documents showing the specifications?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品の案内は家にあります。数字を覚えていないので、容量を推測して書かず資料を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容量を推測せず仕様資料を持参する意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The product information is at home. I do not remember the figures, so I will bring the documents rather than guess the capacity and write it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the specifications documents without guessing the capacity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は発送を進めず、資料で内容と利用できる方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us hold off on dispatch for now and use the documents to check the contents and available shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は箱を持ち帰ります。家族にも発送済みとは言わず、電源を送れる条件を確認中だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留して箱を持帰り家族へ条件確認中と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take the box home today. I will not tell my family it has been sent; I will say we are checking the conditions for sending the power supply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will postpone dispatch, take the box home, and tell your family that the conditions are being checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。電源の仕様が分かる資料と箱を、改めてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the box and documents showing the power supply's specifications again.
